description: Narrow first slice (NOYA 2024-04). Three NAME-GATED, two-signal shapes for connector/TVL/position-accounting bugs the existing lenses miss: (A) external-reader position aggregate -> double-count/sign/omission (H-11 SNX, H-19 Morpho); (B) PositionTVL product/division miscalc (H-13 Balancer); (C) registry position-key identity mismatch msg.sender vs calculatorConnector (H-12). Advisory only (is_gate=false); routes high/medium of its own hits via advisory_escalation_gate; de-dups vs arithmetic_conservation; never mints findings. Deferred (need a semantic model): TVL omits staked balance (H-06), tick-liquidity ownership (H-20).
notes: Name-gating to TVL/value/registry functions (the ~25 in NOYA) is the primary FP control. Items already routed by arithmetic_conservation are downgraded to context_only (dedup_arithmetic_conservation) so this lens reports only net-new recovery. Route-rate stays well under noise_audit's 0.50 cap.
